level_rationale: Five weeks of morning stiffness and painful catching in the palm of the right ring finger that pops straight on unbending in a 47-year-old seamstress indicates symptomatic stenosing digital flexor tenosynovitis warranting an outpatient clinic visit for examination, splinting, or local corticosteroid injection rather than unguided self-care or emergency care, whereas a 5-minute mild palm ache in the right ring finger yesterday represents transient occupational hand fatigue needing only routine home self-care.
